subject: [PATCH v2 0/2] mm: page_alloc: fix reserve access for non-blocking requests

reviews.author: Balbir Singh
reviews.summary: Reviewer Balbir Singh suggested reordering the patches to ensure __zone_watermark_unusable_free() accurately accounts for free memory in patch 2, which fixes a watermark check issue.
reviews.raw_body:
I feel patch 2 needs to come first, so that
__zone_watermark_unusable_free() accounts correctly.

Acked-by: Balbir Singh <balbirs@nvidia.com>

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch series fixes two issues related to non-blocking memory allocations interacting with the highatomic reserve in the Linux kernel's page allocation system. The first patch restricts which requests can physically take highatomic pages, while the second patch limits which requests can count them in their watermark check. These changes are necessary because a recent patch by Salvatore would make large page cache folio allocations non-blocking, leading to problems with memory pressure and swapout failures. Without these fixes, GFP_NOWAIT bursts under memory pressure could drain regular free memory to zero while the highatomic reserve sits idle, causing performance issues.
